# proof.ownership.fenced-handoff@1.0.0

This proof pack establishes one finite, declared-world ownership handoff around one fence. It binds complete predecessor and successor attempt/effect populations, distinct authorities and epochs, refusal and effect absence for post-fence predecessor attempts, zero dual-active observations, and ordered pre/post anchor observations to the same resource and fence.

The executable certification includes three non-singleton domains, four truth-level mutants, twelve missing-obligation rejections, 218 immutable fixed negative fixtures, and 218 profile-rebinding witnesses covering every mechanically guarantee-critical profile surface.

The pack does not establish discovery or truthful grounding of undeclared runtime entities, evidence authenticity, wall-clock truth, eventual takeover, a bounded duration, repeated handoffs, or behavior outside its finite declared populations.
